items.title: Main jaanta tha ki kya batana hai.
items.quote: LibertyMD ne timeline aur warning signs organize kar diye, isliye appointment un details se shuru hui jo maayne rakhti thi.

items.title: Agla kadam aakhirkar saaf ho gaya.
items.quote: Baatcheet ne alag kar diya ki ghar par kya monitor kar sakta hoon aur kin symptoms ke liye urgent care chahiye.

items.title: Doctor ke liye behtar sawaal the.
items.quote: Dozen bhar pages padhne ke bajaye, mere paas ek chhoti report aur focused sawaalon ki list thi.

items.title: Warning signs samajhna aasaan ho gaya.
items.quote: Safety sawaal shaant aur seedhe the. Main samajh gaya ki same-day care kyun zaroori hai aur clinician ko kya batana hai.

items.title: Dobara shuru kiye bina aage badh saka.
items.quote: Meri timeline, medications aur agle kadam saath rahe, isliye follow-up baatcheet kaafi kam bikhri hui thi.

items.title: Raat bhar kya dekhna hai, pata tha.
items.quote: Plan ne hydration, temperature aur un badlaavon ke liye practical checkpoints diye jinke baad madad leni thi.

items.title: Baatcheet ne mere options simple kar diye.
items.quote: Main bata saka ki maine kya try kiya hai aur samajh saka ki pharmacist aur doctor se kya poochhna hai.

items.title: Sujan ke baare me andaza lagana band ho gaya.
items.quote: LibertyMD ne chot ko saaf tarike se batane me madad ki aur samjhaya ki examination ya imaging kab sahi rahegi.

items.title: Faisla lete waqt zyada shaant tha.
items.quote: Sawaalon ne samajhne me madad ki ki kya badla hai aur meri maa ko aage kis tarah ki care chahiye.

items.title: Pattern aakhirkar dikhne laga.
items.quote: Timing aur triggers ek saath dekhkar lambi baatcheet ke liye kaafi behtar shuruaat mili.

items.title: Agla kadam chunne se pehle soch saka.
items.quote: Summary ne meri chintaon ke liye shabd diye, bina situation ko zaroorat se zyada darawna banaye.

items.title: Koi zaroori baat chhooti nahi.
items.quote: Symptom ke badlaav, sawaal aur agle kadam — sab ek jagah the jo main follow-up me cover karna chahta tha.

items.question: LibertyMD kya kar sakta hai?
items.answer: LibertyMD ek private AI care chat hai jo aapke symptoms par usi tarah kaam karta hai jaise ek clinician karega — onset, timing, severity, aur kis cheez se aaram ya takleef badhti hai. Chalte-chalte urgent red flags check karta hai, fir poori baatcheet ko ek doctor-ready health report me badal deta hai jise aap kisi bhi appointment me le ja sakte hain. Chat, screening, report aur aapke follow-up sawaal — sab free hain.

items.question: LibertyMD kaun use kar sakta hai?
items.answer: LibertyMD 18 saal se upar ke adults ke liye hai. Aap bina account ke shuru kar sakte hain aur anonymous reh sakte hain — hum age aur sex assigned at birth sirf isliye poochhte hain kyunki inse symptoms ka matlab badal jaata hai. 18 saal se kam umar ke liye kripya aise clinician ya service ka upyog karein jo bachchon aur kishoron ki dekhbhaal karti ho.

items.question: Kya LibertyMD doctor se milne ka vikalp hai?
items.answer: Nahi. LibertyMD aapko samajhne me madad karta hai ki aap kya mehsoos kar rahe hain aur care ke liye taiyaari karta hai — yeh khud se diagnosis ya treatment nahi karta. Har consult ke ant me care ke sahi level ki saaf sifarish milti hai, saath me ek report jo aage ki appointment ko zyada useful banati hai. Jab aap clinician ko shaamil karna chaahein, doctor consultation $39 ka hai.

items.question: Iski keemat kitni hai?
items.answer: AI care chat, urgency aur red-flag screening, aapki health report, aur unlimited follow-up sawaal free hain. Doctor consultation $39 ka hai, aur prescription support $0 se shuru hota hai. Koi subscription nahi aur insurance zaroori nahi, aur FSA aur HSA cards accept kiye jaate hain.

items.question: Kya meri health information private hai?
items.answer: Haan. LibertyMD HIPAA compliant hai, aur aap bina account banaye ya naam diye baatcheet shuru kar sakte hain. Aapka consult aapka hi rehta hai — aap tay karte hain ki report email karni hai, kisi clinician ke saath share karni hai, ya apne paas hi rakhni hai.

items.question: Agar mujhe medical emergency ho to?
items.answer: 911 par call karein ya abhi nazdeeki emergency room jaayein — AI consult ka intezaar na karein. LibertyMD poori baatcheet me emergency red flags check karta hai aur milne par interview rok kar aapko emergency care lene ko kahega, lekin yeh emergency services ka vikalp nahi hai.
